title: Enterprise zones including proposed Nāpili zone
summary: On December 5, the council adopted Resolution 25-193, the enterprise zone resolution, with seven ayes, sending the request toward the governor, whose approval is due by April 30. Current zone designations expire April 30, 2026, and new zones take effect May 1. An earlier vote on November 7 tied four to four, and the mayor's economic development office has said it will do its own community outreach.

timeline.text: The council adopted Resolution 25-193, the enterprise zone resolution, with seven ayes.
The vice chair said she will work with a council member to answer her questions and work on the enterprise zone item again.
The first vote on both resolutions tied, four ayes to four noes.
